decisions.summary: Wave 88 takes a pre-existing defect (not a ranked row) under constitution XIV: seed 22's row road, laid over a recorded ford by ford_crossing, was threaded whole by _thread_the_fabric, which dropped the landings, so the road crossed the brook 64 px off any ford and was refused (off_ford); seed 03 the same
decisions.why: Adds work and narrows nothing. The request is to make the implementation match the research; 0035's drawing page already has a way cross the brook square at a ford, and the fix makes that existing rule hold through the threading. XIV (GM 2026-10-01) has defects found in the work fixed in that work, as waves 86 and 87 did. The unit is under hamletgen/, inside FR-010's scope. No ranked row is skipped or re-tiered.

decisions.summary: thread_over_the_ford threads each leg to its landing apart and keeps the deck between the two landings
decisions.why: The direct implementation of 0035's 'a way crosses the brook at a ford' (ford_crossing's own claim cites the same page). It narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Taken only where the landing pair's middle is a recorded ford; otherwise the run is threaded whole as before
decisions.why: Not a carve-out in effect: ford_crossing returns landings only at a recorded ford (its midpoint is the ford by construction, checks.py lines 145-150), so the guard is true whenever a ford crossing was laid; where none was laid there is no deck to keep, and the off_ford law still refuses any crossing off a ford. No crossing off a ford is admitted by this branch.

decisions.summary: Where a threaded leg is clipped short of its landing, the whole run is threaded as before
decisions.why: A fallback to the pre-existing path, not an exception to the research: that path's output is still judged by off_ford (law.py) and refused if it crosses off a ford, exactly as at HEAD. Nothing that breaks 0035 ships through it; it only keeps a seed from failing differently than before.

decisions.summary: Applied to the row road and the field spur in stage_track (the two runs in track.py laid over a ford and then threaded); the web's arms and the connector are not touched this wave
decisions.why: The scope of a defect fix, not a narrowing of the request: the measured defect is the row road (seeds 03, 22), the spur is the other track.py run built as [start, landings, end] and threaded, and the GM's request does not ask for this defect at all. The off_ford law covers every way, so no unfixed way can ship off a ford; any further instance is a new XIV find for its own wave.

decisions.summary: Kashikawa's row road re-placed (runs on taut from its ford, one bend fewer); declared as a placement-changed occasion (village lane on kashikawa) for a glyph-check at batch 11's close; Sawada moved in draw order only
decisions.why: Feature 294's occasion rule as the plan has applied it every batch; a map move that follows the research needs no ask (GM 2026-09-12). The reviewer did not re-render Kashikawa; the occasion is where it is looked at. Sawada MEASURED (HEAD vs working-tree manifest, order-insensitive): all 20 lanes' geometry identical, only z shifted by one, so no occasion is owed there; but its manifest meta also changed - field_spur_swept 'isolated - no house of its own and no join to the web' -> 'folded back short of the field - the ground between is marsh a path may not cross', and lane_fragments_dropped 1 -> absent. Nothing drawn differs, but 'draw order only' in the plan and m:wave88-road-over-its-ford's pool value understates it; a wording correction, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: A Decisions Recorded row in spec.md, class HISTORICALLY ACCURATE (0035), pointing at thread_over_the_ford, with m:wave88-road-over-its-ford
decisions.why: FR-008 owes a row for a fix that changes what a map draws (Kashikawa moved); the class follows the cited page, whose drawing note has a way cross square at a ford and bridges() deck it.

decisions.summary: Verification: test_track.py (leg by leg; no recorded ford, whole; a leg clipped short, whole), seeds 03 and 22 and the 48-seed cohort (49 -> 51/54, none newly failing), impl-drift on the claims owed (T205), spec-fidelity; gate and occasions at batch 11's close
decisions.why: FR-005's batched verification. The reviewer re-ran on the uncommitted engine: make test-file tests/hamletgen/ways/test_track.py 30 passed; make cohort N=1 SEED=22 7/7 passed; make cohort N=1 SEED=3 7/7 passed. The 48-seed cohort was not re-run.
